items.title: 아주 긴 프로젝트 제목이 카드와 상세 화면에서 여러 줄로 줄바꿈되는 경우 — An Exceptionally Long Project Title
items.summary: 사용자의 문제를 끝까지 따라가 설계하고, 검증할 수 있는 인터페이스로 마무리하는 제품 디자이너이자 개발자입니다. 긴 한국어 문장이 여러 줄로 나뉘어도 레이아웃이 무너지지 않아야 합니다.
items.description: Replace this starter project with a real case study. Describe the context, your contribution, and why the work mattered.
highlights: Clarified the core user journey and reduced the interface to the essential steps.
Built a reusable component system with responsive and keyboard-friendly states.
Documented the main technical decisions and verification path.
items.problem: The initial workflow was fragmented, making the primary task difficult to discover and complete.
items.solution: A focused information architecture and reusable interface system turned the workflow into a clear sequence.

architecture.summary: A content-driven Next.js interface with typed boundaries and reusable presentation components.
items: Structured content as validated data rather than page-level hardcoded copy.
Separated route data from visual presentation so multiple designs can share one source.
Added automated checks for the primary user paths.

decisions: Kept project content independent from presentation-specific markup.
Used one canonical project identifier across resume, journey, curation, and interview references.
tradeoffs: The starter uses placeholder artwork so adopters must add authentic project evidence.
A compact example is easier to understand but does not demonstrate every optional content pattern.
results: A complete example route that renders in all five visual templates.
A safe reference for adding more projects without breaking cross-file links.
